added_failures_note: the reviewed run armed no suite: its manifest tests line reads none and the manifest carries no baseline_suite or after_suite arm, so no gate-log pair exists from which to derive an added-failure delta and the count is zero by that absence, not by a green pair. The absence is checked rather than assumed: the manifest's keys were read and neither arm is present. Its one guard, check_units.py, was re-run by this review and exits 0 at the head.

findings.detail: Reproduced from the code and the receipt this round reads. scripts/prototypes/solve_wall_breakdown/measure.py:318-323 sets results['operand_load_seconds'] from the wall of certificate_fixtures.cached_carrier(...) only, and cached_carrier -> fixture.cached_machine (scripts/prototypes/support/certificate_fixtures.py:267-282, scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/measure.py:897-931) loads one carrier dataset and nothing else. The jet matrix is built and loaded by the separate scripts/prototypes/lean_map/jets.py:31 build_jets call at measure.py:242 and recorded in its own top-level 'jets' block, whose load_seconds is 0.1806 cold and 0.1823 on the step arm (logs/h200c/stages.json, logs/h200h/stages.json). The carrier's own store read inside that 0.690 s window is 0.199 s (operand_load_cache.load_seconds), so 0.199 + 0.181 does not reach 0.690 either: the 0.690 s is one carrier reload, not the sum of the operand store. The same unsupported containment is repeated at :21 ("the jet matrix is 0.181 s of that") and at :110 ("with the 166.7 MB jet matrix 0.181 s of that"), and :24 additionally calls a single carrier reload "the whole operand store" one clause after calling the same load 0.651 s. The prior review raised this area as non-blocking finding 44e635e1d9a, whose wording was "operand_load_seconds 0.690 (carrier ...)"; this round answered it by asserting a containment the receipt does not support. The numbers are right and the relation between them is not.
findings.summary: The cold-arm sentence states that the 166.7 MB jet matrix is 0.181 s "of" the 0.690 s operand-store load, but the 0.690 s times certificate_fixtures.cached_carrier alone and the jets are a separate build_jets load with its own receipt entry, so the containment is not measured and the "whole operand store" figure omits the jets.

findings.detail: Reproduced: replacing the summary with "Cold stage total is 29.0 s; ..." and running check_units.py at the reviewed head prints UNIT CHECK OK: 52 stated values agree with the receipt and exits 0, because the missing match makes headline_cold_total return None at check_units.py:101-105 and 29.0 s then matches the 28.996 s XLA total already in the seconds bag. The guard does fire on the defect that motivated it: against the pre-round fragment at 1d210c9e5 it exits 1 naming 29.0 s against the 34.933 s receipt total, and the guard as of b999d8534 exits 0 on that same file, which confirms the gap this round closed. The residual weakness is that the check keys on one sentence shape; a guard that returns None on a shape it does not recognise reports the same thing as a guard that found nothing wrong.
findings.summary: headline_cold_total returns None instead of a problem when the plan-summary does not match its "compile[^.]*?is <n> s" pattern, so the guard the round added checks nothing on a rephrased headline and a wrong cold total passes.
